scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof with independent small-parameter exhaustive computations. Computational tests are finite corroboration and do not certify the universal theorem. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields, nondegenerate symmetric forms, all ordered entries mutually annihilating including squares, labeled tuples rather than isometry orbits. Priority provisional: a general incidence theorem might imply these formulas.
title: Rank-vector enumeration of mutually annihilating self-adjoint operators over finite orthogonal spaces
